messages:
maria: Working on a compact sidebar IA prototype. Goal: fewer top-level items, clearer groupings, preserve deep-linking. Prototype will collapse similar items into a new 'Workflows' group.

sam: That sounds promising. Important: keep stable routes for models and datasets. Some customers embed deep links in docs.

devon: Route stability priority. If we must change paths, add explicit aliases in router and return a canonical header so client shows proper breadcrumbs.

maria: Sketch of alias table I'll attach: ```js
const aliases = {
  '/datasets': '/data/assets',
  '/deploys': '/workflows/deploys',
  '/models/:id': '/models/:id'
};
```

navin: Make sure analytics are handled: preserve utm params and don't double-count pageviews when redirecting. Also pins/bookmarks need migration.

tia: UX: show canonical breadcrumb (e.g., Workflows > Deploys) and a subtle banner: "You're viewing via an older link—we've mapped it to the new nav." Banner should be dismissible and aria-live polite.

devon: Accessibility: banner must not steal focus; use role="status" or aria-live="polite". Left nav collapse/expand must announce state. Breadcrumb should be in a <nav aria-label="Breadcrumb">.

sam: For client behavior: router middleware sets x-canonical-path. Client can history.replaceState(canonical) so back button remains correct. Use replaceState, not pushState.

navin: For bookmarks migration, run a dry-run job to rewrite user pins to canonical paths and report mismatches. We'll only write changes after validation.

maria: Copy tweak idea for banner: "This link uses an older console path. We've redirected you to the new navigation. Report a broken link." Keep CTA tiny.

tia: Edge-case: deep links that open modals (e.g., ?modal=edit) should preserve query params and trigger the modal after mapping.

devon: Telemetry event: nav_alias_resolved { from, to, user_id, action } so we can measure alias usage and whether to prune aliases.

maria: Rollout plan: feature-flag compact sidebar + alias middleware. Start with internal users and a handful of beta orgs. Monitor alias telemetry and support queue.

design-bot: Reminder: bring Figma mock and alias CSV to review on Thu 11am.

maria: I'll upload mocks and CSV today. Who can review router middleware?

devon: I'll review the router PR, will check replaceState and header semantics.

sam: I'll help with the bookmarks migration dry-run.

maria: Thanks! Next: Figma + CSV by EOD, draft middleware with x-canonical-path header and telemetry, a11y checklist updates. I'll post screenshots in follow-up.
